protocol_metadata.about: The Vault is a Solana liquid staking protocol that allows users to stake SOL in exchange for vSOL, a liquid staking receipt token. The protocol delegates stake across community-focused validators to promote decentralization while enabling stakers to maintain liquidity and participate in DeFi. Governance is managed by $V token holders who vote on protocol direction and validator selection.
